data.statement: Rebuild Cleanup V2 and its Chunking integration around deterministic structural analysis, zero introduced word fusion, one resumable cleanup.json contract, bounded model-agnostic LLM adjudication, semantic line breaks, eight supported languages, and the existing Cleanup UI.

acceptance: Automated Cleanup introduces zero word fusions and zero unauthorized source-projection loss.
join_without_space is removed; only validated dehyphenate and join_preserving_hyphen transformations may remove boundary whitespace.
Every boundary has one typed resolution, including semantic line breaks; no newline remains unclassified.
Native structure is authoritative, roles precede boundary decisions, and page-artifact removal cannot concatenate body units.
Cleanup completes deterministically without a usable LLM and isolates provider failures per batch.
LLM batching adapts to context, splits until fit, uses strict output, and verifies prior overrides.
cleanup.json checkpoints analysis and adjudication; compatible resume skips work and model/context/prompt changes redo only AI decisions.
Only completed metadata with matching output hash is consumable; finalization recovery rerenders without LLM.
Manual edits retain truthful structure/provenance and invalidate downstream work.
The existing Cleanup UI layout and controls remain; new state is shown through the existing progress dialog and status pane.
Chunking prioritizes semantic cuts, avoids mid-sentence cuts except unavoidable overflow, and treats size balance as soft.
Benchmark results are zero of the measured 36 fusions remaining, 27/27 page transitions resolved, and paragraph F1 at least 0.97.
Focused/full pytest and ruff gates pass; no commit, push, PR, or merge is performed.
assumptions: Supported content languages are en, ro, de, fr, ru, pt, es, and it; dominant CJK or Hangul content is rejected.
cleanup.json is checkpoint and final metadata; clean_text.txt is the only text output; no schema version or migration branch remains.
The existing Cleanup UI layout and controls remain visually unchanged.
open_questions: Approve the high-risk replacement of the Cleanup persistence contract and its cross-component Chunking integration under the accepted no-compatibility plan?
data.reason: Repository policy requires a human checkpoint because the approved plan replaces durable contracts across two high-criticality components.
recommended_responses: Approved: continue gate-by-gate through delivery without publication; preserve the current UI layout and leave final interactive testing to the user.
scope: In scope: eight-language configuration, Cleanup analysis/rendering/quality/LLM/persistence/resume/manual edits, existing Cleanup UI integration, and Chunking consumption of roles and semantic boundaries. Out of scope: new UI controls/pages, CJK/Hangul support, image-only PDF OCR, prior Cleanup compatibility or migration, commits, pushes, PRs, merges, and operator acceptance testing.
data.source: Approved Cleanup + Chunking V2 plan and follow-up decisions in Codex conversation, 2026-07-28.
data.understanding: Replace the committed hybrid Cleanup V2 contract with a quality-first deterministic structural pipeline using one resumable cleanup.json plus clean_text.txt, safe typed boundary decisions, bounded model-agnostic LLM adjudication, compatible resume, unchanged Cleanup UI layout, and typed Cleanup structure consumed by Chunking.
